jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are currently looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our dynamic and diverse global legal team based in our corporate headquarters in Zurich.  Leveraging on your broad experience of commercial contracts, you will be responsible for managing a broad range of corporate, commercial and legal operational matters.  This is an ideal opportunity for someone looking to apply their experience in a law firm in an in-house legal function or continue their corporate journey in the exciting world of chocolate and cocoa!

Key Responsibilities Include

• Provide general legal advice to the business and proactively manage and mitigate legal and regulatory risks related to Switzerland and our Global Cocoa & Sourcing organization

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, mainly related to sourcing activities and the manufacture, supply and distribution of our products

• Oversee and manage litigation and commercial disputes

• Support key legal operations processes, including corporate housekeeping, claims management and contract lifecycle management

• Support the implementation of the Group’s ESG and Sustainability strategy

About You

• 3-5 years of work experience in an internationally orientated law firm or a multinational company, ideally in a similar industry (i.e. food, manufacturing, commodity trading and sourcing)

• Master Degree in law, Swiss bar exam preferred

• Solid experience in Swiss corporate law and contract drafting

• High degree of professional ethics and integrity

• High analytical and conceptual skills combined with the ability to simplify complex matter

• Outstanding communication skills and ability to work and communicate with all levels of the organization

• Excellent command of English and German

• A flexible, proactive, solution-oriented mind-set with a “can do” spirit and the ability to pragmatically solve legal issues and being able to prioritize under pressure

• Laurea magistrale in diritto, esame bar svizzero preferito

• Esperienza solida nel diritto societario svizzero e nella redazione dei contratti

• Alto grado di etica e integrità professionale

• Alte competenze analitiche e concettuali combinate con la capacità di semplificare la materia complessa

• Capacità di comunicazione eccezionale e capacità di lavorare e comunicare con tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione

• Ottimo comando di inglese e tedesco

• Una mentalità flessibile, proattiva, orientata alla soluzione con uno spirito “può fare” e la capacità di risolvere pragmaticamente le questioni legali e di essere in grado di privilegiare sotto pressione

jobs.title: Head of Internal Communications
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Head of Internal Communications leads Barry Callebaut’s global internal communications strategy and newsroom, connecting and mobilizing employees around key business priorities. Acting as the organization’s "red thread," this role owns the internal corporate narrative, ensures consistent messaging across functions, regions, and leadership, and translates strategy into clear, actionable communications. The role reports directly to the VP, Corporate Communications & Public Affairs, and partners closely with the Executive Leadership Team, regional communicators, and external communications to drive alignment, engagement, and business impact.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Own and drive the company’s internal narrative, translating business strategy, priorities, and transformation initiatives into clear, compelling and consistent communications that align employees around what matters most.

• Lead the global internal newsroom and editorial strategy, defining content priorities, governance, publishing standards, and managing the editorial calendar to ensure timely, relevant and impactful communications.

• Serve as a strategic communications advisor to the Executive Leadership Team and senior leaders, shaping key messages, executive storytelling, town halls, enterprise announcements and leadership visibility initiatives.

• Develop communication frameworks, guidance and toolkits that enable leaders and managers to communicate effectively, consistently and with confidence across the organization.

• Build strong partnerships across functions, regions and business units, ensuring alignment of communication strategies, coordinated activation and consistent messaging globally.

• Drive employee engagement and organizational alignment through communications that connect employees to business strategy, performance, culture, values and transformation efforts, while fostering dialogue and feedback.

• Lead integrated internal and external storytelling, partnering with External Communications to ensure a consistent company narrative and identify opportunities to strengthen corporate reputation.

• Leverage data, insights and AI-driven capabilities to optimize content effectiveness, improve personalization, strengthen measurement and enhance the overall employee communications experience.

• Drive innovation across communication channels, content formats and digital platforms, continuously testing new approaches to increase relevance, reach and engagement.

• Lead and develop the Internal Communications team, setting priorities, establishing governance and best practices, coaching team members, and building a high-performing culture that embraces AI-enabled ways of working while maintaining strong editorial standards.

About You

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, Business, or related field.

• Experience: 10+ years of communications experience, including significant experience in internal communications, corporate communications, newsroom management, or executive communications within a global organization.

• Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading communications teams and influencing senior stakeholders.

• Language Skills: Full professional fluency in English.

• Strategic Communications Expertise: Demonstrated ability to develop communication strategies that support business transformation and organizational priorities.

• Executive Communications: Strong experience advising senior leaders and creating leadership communication frameworks.

• Editorial & Content Leadership: Expertise in storytelling, content strategy, newsroom operations, and digital communications.

• Channel Management: Strong knowledge of intranet platforms, employee engagement tools, leadership communications channels, video, and digital content.

• Measurement & Analytics: Experience using communication metrics and insights to guide decision-making and improve effectiveness.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Il capo delle comunicazioni interne conduce la strategia globale di comunicazione interna di Barry Callebaut e la redazione, collegando e mobilitando i dipendenti in base alle priorità aziendali chiave. Agire come "filo rosso" dell'organizzazione, questo ruolo possiede la narrazione aziendale interna, assicura la messaggistica coerente tra funzioni, regioni e leadership, e traduce la strategia in comunicazioni chiare e attuabili. Il ruolo si riferisce direttamente al VP, Corporate Communications & Public Affairs, e collabora strettamente con il Executive Leadership Team, comunicatori regionali e comunicazioni esterne per guidare l'allineamento, l'impegno e l'impatto aziendale.

Responsabilità chiave

• Possedere e guidare la narrazione interna dell'azienda, tradurre strategia aziendale, priorità e iniziative di trasformazione in comunicazioni chiare, convincenti e coerenti che allineano i dipendenti intorno a ciò che più conta.

• Guidare la redazione e la redazione globale, definendo le priorità dei contenuti, la governance, gli standard editoriali e la gestione del calendario editoriale per garantire comunicazioni tempestive, pertinenti e di impatto.

• Servire come consulente di comunicazione strategica per il Team Executive Leadership e leader senior, modellare messaggi chiave, storytelling esecutivo, sale comunali, annunci di impresa e iniziative di visibilità della leadership.

• Sviluppare framework di comunicazione, guide e toolkit che permettono ai leader e manager di comunicare in modo efficace, coerente e con fiducia in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Costruire partnership forti tra funzioni, regioni e business unit, garantendo l'allineamento delle strategie di comunicazione, l'attivazione coordinata e la messaggistica coerente a livello globale.

• Guidare l'impegno dei dipendenti e l'allineamento organizzativo attraverso le comunicazioni che collegano i dipendenti alla strategia aziendale, alle prestazioni, alla cultura, ai valori e agli sforzi di trasformazione, promuovendo al contempo il dialogo e il feedback.

• Guidare lo storytelling interno ed esterno integrato, collaborando con le comunicazioni esterne per garantire una narrazione aziendale coerente e identificare le opportunità per rafforzare la reputazione aziendale.

• Leva i dati, le intuizioni e le capacità guidate dall'IA per ottimizzare l'efficacia dei contenuti, migliorare la personalizzazione, rafforzare la misurazione e migliorare l'esperienza di comunicazione dei dipendenti.

• Guida l'innovazione attraverso canali di comunicazione, formati di contenuti e piattaforme digitali, testando continuamente nuovi approcci per aumentare la pertinenza, la portata e il coinvolgimento.

• Guidare e sviluppare il team di Comunicazione Interna, stabilire le priorità, stabilire la governance e le migliori pratiche, allenare i membri del team, e la costruzione di una cultura ad alto rendimento che abbraccia i modi di lavorare abilitati all'AI mantenendo forti standard editoriali.

A proposito di te

• Istruzione: Corso di laurea in Comunicazione, Giornalismo, Relazioni pubbliche, Marketing, Business o campo relativo.

• Esperienza: 10+ anni di esperienza di comunicazione, tra cui significativa esperienza nelle comunicazioni interne, nelle comunicazioni aziendali, nella gestione delle newsroom o nelle comunicazioni esecutive all'interno di un'organizzazione globale.

• Esperienza di leadership: esperienza comprovata leader team di comunicazione e influenzare gli stakeholder senior.

• Competenze linguistiche: Fluenza professionale completa in inglese.

• Esperti di comunicazioni strategiche: capacità dimostrata di sviluppare strategie di comunicazione che supportano la trasformazione aziendale e le priorità organizzative.

• Comunicazioni esecutive: forte esperienza consigliando i leader senior e creando quadri di comunicazione di leadership.

• Editoriale & Content Leadership: Competenza nella narrazione, nella strategia dei contenuti, nelle operazioni di redazione e nelle comunicazioni digitali.

• Gestione del canale: Forte conoscenza delle piattaforme intranet, strumenti di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti, canali di comunicazione di leadership, video e contenuti digitali.

• Misurazione e analisi: esperienza utilizzando metriche di comunicazione e approfondimenti per guidare il processo decisionale e migliorare l'efficacia.

Über die Rolle

Der Leiter der internen Kommunikation leitet die globale interne Kommunikationsstrategie und den Newsroom von Barry Callebaut und verbindet und mobilisiert Mitarbeiter um wichtige Geschäftsprioritäten. Als "roter Faden" der Organisation ist diese Rolle Eigentümer der internen Unternehmenserzählung, gewährleistet eine konsistente Kommunikation über Funktionen, Regionen und Führung hinweg und übersetzt Strategie in klare, umsetzbare Kommunikation. Die Rolle berichtet direkt an den VP, Corporate Communications & Public Affairs und arbeitet eng mit dem Executive Leadership Team, regionalen Kommunikatoren und externer Kommunikation zusammen, um Ausrichtung, Engagement und Geschäftswirkung zu fördern.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören

• Besitzen und treiben Sie die interne Erzählung des Unternehmens, übersetzen Sie Geschäftsstrategie, Prioritäten und Transformationsinitiativen in klare, überzeugende und konsistente Kommunikation, die die Mitarbeiter auf das Wesentliche ausrichtet.

• Führen Sie die globale interne Redaktions- und Redaktionsstrategie, definieren Sie Inhaltsprioritäten, Governance, Veröffentlichungsstandards und verwalten Sie den Redaktionskalender, um eine zeitnahe, relevante und wirkungsvolle Kommunikation zu gewährleisten.

• Dienen Sie als strategischer Kommunikationsberater für das Executive Leadership Team und leitende Führungskräfte und gestalten Sie Schlüsselbotschaften, Executive Storytelling, Rathäuser, Unternehmensankündigungen und Initiativen zur Sichtbarkeit von Führungskräften.

• Entwickeln Sie Kommunikationsrahmen, Anleitungen und Toolkits, die es Führungskräften und Managern ermöglichen, effektiv, konsistent und vertrauensvoll im gesamten Unternehmen zu kommunizieren.

• Aufbau starker Partnerschaften zwischen Funktionen, Regionen und Geschäftseinheiten, um die Ausrichtung von Kommunikationsstrategien, koordinierte Aktivierung und konsistentes Messaging weltweit sicherzustellen.

• Förderung von Mitarbeiterengagement und organisatorischer Ausrichtung durch Kommunikation, die Mitarbeiter mit Geschäftsstrategie, Leistung, Kultur, Werten und Transformationsbemühungen verbindet und gleichzeitig Dialog und Feedback fördert.

• Führen Sie integriertes internes und externes Storytelling und arbeiten Sie mit External Communications zusammen, um eine konsistente Unternehmenserzählung zu gewährleisten und Möglichkeiten zur Stärkung der Unternehmensreputation zu identifizieren.

• Nutzen Sie Daten, Erkenntnisse und KI-gesteuerte Fähigkeiten, um die Effektivität von Inhalten zu optimieren, die Personalisierung zu verbessern, die Messung zu stärken und die gesamte Kommunikationserfahrung der Mitarbeiter zu verbessern.

• Förderung von Innovationen über Kommunikationskanäle, Inhaltsformate und digitale Plattformen hinweg, wobei kontinuierlich neue Ansätze getestet werden, um Relevanz, Reichweite und Engagement zu erhöhen.

• Führen und entwickeln Sie das Team für interne Kommunikation, setzen Sie Prioritäten, etablieren Sie Governance und Best Practices, coachen Sie Teammitglieder und bauen Sie eine leistungsstarke Kultur auf, die KI-fähige Arbeitsweisen umfasst und gleichzeitig starke redaktionelle Standards beibehält.

Über dich

• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Kommunikation, Journalismus, Public Relations, Marketing, Business oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Erfahrung: 10+ Jahre Kommunikationserfahrung, einschließlich erheblicher Erfahrung in der internen Kommunikation, Unternehmenskommunikation, Redaktionsmanagement oder Exekutivkommunikation innerhalb einer globalen Organisation.

• Führungserfahrung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Kommunikationsteams und der Beeinflussung leitender Stakeholder.

• Sprachkenntnisse: Volle professionelle Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch.

• Strategische Kommunikationskompetenz: Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Kommunikationsstrategien zu entwickeln, die die Geschäftstransformation und organisatorische Prioritäten unterstützen.

• Executive Communications: Starke Erfahrung in der Beratung von Führungskräften und der Erstellung von Führungskommunikationsrahmen.

• Editorial & Content Leadership: Expertise in Storytelling, Content-Strategie, Newsroom-Betrieb und digitaler Kommunikation.

• Channel Management: Starkes Wissen über Intranetplattformen, Mitarbeiterbindungstools, Führungskommunikationskanäle, Videos und digitale Inhalte.

• Messung & Analytik: Erfahrung mit Kommunikationsmetriken und Erkenntnissen, um die Entscheidungsfindung zu leiten und die Effektivität zu verbessern.

À propos du rôle

Le chef de la communication interne dirige la stratégie globale de communication interne et la salle de nouvelles de Barry Callebaut, connectant et mobilisant les employés autour des principales priorités opérationnelles. Agissant comme le « fil rouge » de l'organisation, ce rôle possède le récit interne de l'organisation, assure la cohérence des messages entre les fonctions, les régions et le leadership, et traduit la stratégie en communications claires et réalisables. Ce rôle relève directement du vice-président, Communications ministérielles et affaires publiques, et s'associe étroitement avec l'équipe de direction, les communicateurs régionaux et les communications externes pour favoriser l'harmonisation, l'engagement et l'impact opérationnel.

Responsabilités clés

• Posséder et diriger le récit interne de l'entreprise, traduire la stratégie d'affaires, les priorités et les initiatives de transformation en communications claires, convaincantes et cohérentes qui harmonisent les employés autour de ce qui compte le plus.

• Diriger la stratégie globale interne de la salle de presse et de la rédaction, définir les priorités de contenu, la gouvernance, les normes de publication et gérer le calendrier éditorial pour assurer des communications opportunes, pertinentes et efficaces.

• Servir de conseiller en communications stratégiques auprès de l'équipe de leadership de la direction et des hauts dirigeants, façonner les messages clés, raconter des histoires de la direction, des mairies, des annonces d'entreprise et des initiatives de visibilité du leadership.

• Élaborer des cadres de communication, des directives et des trousses d'outils qui permettent aux dirigeants et aux gestionnaires de communiquer efficacement, de façon uniforme et avec confiance dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• Établir des partenariats solides entre les fonctions, les régions et les unités opérationnelles, en assurant l'harmonisation des stratégies de communication, une activation coordonnée et une messagerie cohérente à l'échelle mondiale.

• Encourager l'engagement des employés et l'harmonisation organisationnelle au moyen de communications qui relient les employés à la stratégie opérationnelle, au rendement, à la culture, aux valeurs et aux efforts de transformation, tout en favorisant le dialogue et la rétroaction.

• Diriger la narration intégrée interne et externe, en partenariat avec Communications externes, afin d'assurer un récit cohérent de l'entreprise et de cerner les occasions de renforcer la réputation de l'entreprise.

• Tirer parti des données, des connaissances et des capacités de l'IA pour optimiser l'efficacité du contenu, améliorer la personnalisation, renforcer la mesure et améliorer l'expérience globale de communication des employés.

• Encourager l'innovation à travers les canaux de communication, les formats de contenu et les plateformes numériques, tester continuellement de nouvelles approches pour accroître la pertinence, la portée et l'engagement.

• Diriger et développer l'équipe des communications internes, établir les priorités, établir la gouvernance et les pratiques exemplaires, encadrer les membres de l'équipe et bâtir une culture à haut rendement qui englobe les méthodes de travail adaptées à l'IA tout en maintenant de solides normes éditoriales.

À propos de toi

• Éducation: Baccalauréat en communications, journalisme, relations publiques, marketing, affaires, ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience : plus de 10 ans d'expérience en communications, y compris une expérience importante en communications internes, en communications corporatives, en gestion des salles de presse ou en communications de cadres au sein d'une organisation mondiale.

• Expérience en leadership : Expérience éprouvée de diriger des équipes de communication et d'influencer les principaux intervenants.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As Director, Group Accounting and Reporting (GAR) – Accounting Policies, you will lead the Group’s accounting policy agenda to ensure high‑quality financial reporting, technical accounting compliance, and consistent application of IFRS across the Group. The role owns the Group accounting policy framework, including policy development, practical implementation across regions and functions, training and communication, monitoring of compliance, and continuous enhancement of accounting practices. This position partners closely with regional finance teams, the Group consolidation function, and cross‑functional stakeholders to deliver accurate reporting, strong governance, and continuous improvement of Group‑wide accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Act as the Group’s senior IFRS technical expert, leading the development, interpretation and maintenance of Group accounting policies and supporting regional and local teams on complex accounting topics and new standards.

• Develop, implement and maintain Group accounting policies, reporting guidelines, and best practices to ensure consistent and practical application across all entities and functions.

• Prepare accounting position papers and implementation guidance

• Monitor emerging IFRS developments and assess their impact on the Group.

• Lead the practical development and implementation of new and revised accounting policies, partnering with regional teams, cross-functional stakeholders and process owners to embed requirements into day-to-day operations.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Finance and other business functions, acting as a trusted advisor on technical accounting matters and policy implementation.

• Drive stakeholder alignment and manage expectations through proactive communication, collaboration and influence, ensuring timely decision-making and consistent adoption of Group accounting policies and reporting standards.

• Develop and deliver training, communication and knowledge-sharing initiatives to strengthen accounting capabilities across the Group.

• Establish monitoring mechanisms to assess policy compliance and drive continuous improvement of policies and related processes.

• Build and maintain a strong internal network across regions and functions (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Legal) to support Group‑wide initiatives.

• Support transformation initiatives, system enhancements, and process optimization projects within Group Finance.

• Provide high‑quality internal reporting and analytical insights on consolidated results to senior management.

• Partner with the Group consolidation team to ensure a smooth, timely, and accurate period close.

• Contribute to the preparation of external disclosures for the Annual Report, Half‑Year Report, and other regulatory filings

About You

• Minimum 10 years in a professional accounting firm (Big 4 a plus) or multinational/listed company environment

• University degree in accounting, together with a professional qualification (CA, ACCA or CPA)

• Exceptional knowledge of technical accounting under IFRS, including policy development, drafting accounting position papers and implementation guidance, training stakeholders, and monitoring compliance in practice.

• Experience in a global team and external reporting for a listed (preferably SIX) entity.

• Demonstrates a positive attitude in a dynamic, matrix and multi-country business environment

• Demonstrated ability to challenge existing processes constructively and drive improvements.

• Strong analytical mindset and ability to work independently under pressure.

• Fluent English, written and spoken. Other languages considered a plus

About the Role

The Cocoa Derivatives Trader serves as a trusted advisor to physical sourcing teams, supporting operations across terminal markets for African, European, and global cocoa flows managed from Zurich. This role is responsible for ensuring that daily risk positions are accurately monitored and remain within established trading limits.

As a co-manager of a proprietary trading book, the trader executes strategies in line with the approved trading mandate and GCRC guidelines. Positioned at the center of all terminal market transactions, the Cocoa Derivatives Trader plays a critical role in building and maintaining strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

The role involves close collaboration with colleagues across Sales, Product Trading, Cocoa Trading, and Chocolate businesses. As a market expert and thought leader, the trader contributes valuable market insights, partners with the Cocoa Research team to develop analyses, and leverages relationships with brokers, banks, Treasury, and Risk teams to support informed trading decisions and strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Execute market trades to hedge price risk accurately and in a timely manner.

• Implement trading strategies in accordance with the approved trading mandate.

• Own and deliver the Trading P&L KPI.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

• Monitor and control daily positions, including the management of any resulting foreign exchange exposure.

• Develop and execute strategies involving futures, options, and OTC instruments.

• Manage expiring positions, coordinate roll activities with brokers and physical counterparties, and optimize transaction costs.

• Proactively cultivate broker relationships and communicate relevant market intelligence to sourcing teams.

• Identify and escalate regulatory, compliance, and control-related issues as appropriate.

• Monitor and support the technology landscape related to market information, market access, position management, and trading activities.

About You

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in commodities trading, terminal markets, and related market practices.

• Strong mathematical, quantitative, and analytical skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Strong interest in technology and digital trading environments.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Effective communicator with strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven mindset.

About the Role

The Cocoa Trader role is part of the Products Trading team based in Zürich. The position is primarily responsible for the external sourcing and subsequent sale of cocoa powder and cake to our European manufacturing sites. In addition, the role supports broader trading activities, including the purchase and sale of cocoa butter and liquor to third-party customers, in line with sales targets and available production capacities.

A key aspect of the role is the monitoring and management of trading exposures and risks arising from intercompany cocoa powder transactions, ensuring effective oversight of the trading book. The position also encompasses responsibilities related to financial transactions, hedging activities, and derivative instruments, contributing to the overall performance and risk management of the trading business.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Manage the procurement of cocoa powder and cocoa cake to support intercompany supply requirements.

• Oversee cocoa powder sales and execution, ensuring a reliable and efficient supply to manufacturing sites across Europe.

• Manage and further develop the supplier portfolio, identifying and evaluating alternative sourcing opportunities.

• Source cocoa products by gathering market intelligence and supplier offers, providing competitive pricing and contributing to trading strategy development.

• Monitor and manage risk exposures arising from cocoa powder trading activities and maintain oversight of the trading book.

• Support cocoa butter and cocoa liquor trading activities, working closely with third-party customers, internal stakeholders, and sales teams.

• Advise customers and sales teams on market developments, pricing, trading strategies, and business opportunities while maintaining key customer relationships.

• Execute cocoa futures and foreign exchange transactions in line with trading objectives and risk management guidelines.

• Resolve quality, logistics, and supply chain issues in collaboration with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.

• Monitor trade execution and physical product flows while developing a strong understanding of product sourcing processes and related operational requirements.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree

• Fluent in English. French / German is a plus

• 5 years of experience in trading/commodities in an international environment

• Capacity to lead other teams

• Good excel and PowerPoint skills as well as good report writing skills

• Team player and capable of working cross-functionally across various stakeholders

• Previous direct customer exposure and combined with presentation skills

• Strong analytical and numerical skills

• Solid understanding of commodities (e.g. cocoa, coffee or other) and international trade

• Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple conflicting priorities

• Able to adapt to a dynamic and changing environment

• Flexible and willing to travel (around 30%)

• Oriented to results

jobs.title: Global Accounts Lead, Sustainability
jobs.description:
About the role:

The Global Accounts Lead, Sustainability, is the first point of contact on all sustainability topics for selected Global Accounts. This role takes the lead for strategic and operational relationships with the sustainability teams of selected Global Accounts. This role is part of the Global Accounts Sustainability Team (which sits within the Customer Solutions Team) and reports to the Head of Global Accounts Sustainability.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to help build upon BC’s customer experience ambition through the development of impact-led initiatives that make a difference on the ground and play a role in shaping the global cocoa and chocolate supply chain.

Key responsibilities include:

• Manage strategic and operational sustainability relationships with selected Global Accounts.

• Convert Global Accounts conventional volumes to sustainable.

• Work in close collaboration with the Head of Global Accounts Sustainability and the Global Sustainability Team to ensure alignment with BC’s sustainability offering and pricing strategy, enabling the sign-off of customer negotiations and contracting.

• Develop end-to-end sustainability strategies and programs to jointly tackle the largest sustainability issues in Cocoa and Chocolate (human rights, forest conservation, poverty, and net zero).

• Collaborate with the Solutions Design team to develop customer programs based on complex briefs.

• Position BC as the leader in sustainability.

• Lead representative & subject matter expert for Forever Chocolate strategy/progress to some of BC’s largest customers.

• Travel requirements: Availability and willingness to travel globally up to 30% of the time. Travel to origin countries including remote in-field trips.

About you:

• Master’s degree in relevant fields such as agronomy, development economics, environmental science, sustainability, or related.

• Business-focused degree in relevant fields such as commerce, supply chain or business administration.

• At least 8 years’ experience in customer-facing or multi-stakeholder roles at the global level in large corporations.

• At least 3-5 years of experience in agribusiness and smallholder sustainability program management (ideally cocoa).

• Experienced cross-functional professional tasked with complex briefs, challenging timelines, and ambiguous and multi-stakeholder environments.

• Broad and deep understanding of major cocoa and chocolate industry sustainability issues i.e. human rights, deforestation, poverty, carbon / SBTi, traceability, and regenerative agriculture.

• Highly skilled in communication, especially in translating complex technical topics into clear and sharp messaging to varied groups of stakeholders and levels of understanding of the topic.

• Analytical and strategic thinker, able to translate customer briefs and available data into well-thought-out customer program strategies and accompanying programs.

• Strong commercial acumen to be able to drive engagement with customers and customer key stakeholder.

• Fluent in English (written, spoken). French, German, Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.
